observabilityGap: Historical confirmed adjudication links may omit providerAck while retaining authorityRef to a committed commandReceipts record. Capture absent/false/true and receipt linkage before any QA predicate change.
requiredReadOnlyEvidence: Exact shopperIdentityLinks and shopperIdentityCrosswalk records for these six source IDs, including exact field and canonical target. identityResolutionLinks in V1 was a logical label, not the physical collection.
Preserve absent/false/true separately for humanConfirmed, providerAck, sourceSafe and fuzzyMatching.
Read tenant/project/period scope, status, authorityType, authorityRef, adjudicationId, providerAckRef, commandId, idempotencyKey and nested authority references when present.
Read only the referenced durable command/adjudication receipts and check operation, committed state, exact alias/target, scope and provider ACK.
forbiddenInferences: Do not approve by shared destination alone.
Do not infer identity by name normalization or fuzzy matching.
Do not treat absent providerAck as proof of no remote ACK.
Do not create or reimport identity data to make the test pass.
nextDecisionRule: If current durable authority already proves an exact alias, repair only the QA reader/diagnostic owner with positive and negative tests. If authority is missing, retain HOLD and resolve under the existing functional contract and authorization; no silent alias acceptance.

seedAuthority.seedLimit: Candidate paths only. Exact aliases, conflict queries and current durable receipts are still required.
